Full semantics of translation mode adjustment during trampoline relocation.
Complete guest host protocol versions message encodings and termination code meanings.
Full identification function entry layout and subleaf handling beyond range maxima.
Secure service invocation protocol beyond calling area address recording.
Complete trusted domain hypercall argument block layout and error meanings beyond success indication.
Full boot parameter block layout and EFI table discovery details beyond observed lookups.
Exact numeric values of required capability masks and capability string table contents.

findings.text: The early boot code makes available a predicate that tells whether decoded instruction prefixes contain a repeat kind for secure virtualization handling.
The early boot code makes available a decoder that fills an emulation context from bytes found at the saved instruction location using long mode.
The compressed boot stage makes available a handler for virtualization communication exceptions that serves timing port and identification exits.
A shared helper that finds confidential computing blob information from boot setup data is usable by decompressor and early startup phases.
A shared accessor that returns the internal copy of the firmware supplied identification table for secure nested paging is available to early code.
A shared helper that reports hypervisor capability bits through guest host communication is available when protocol version allows.
The compressed boot makes available an initializer that enables secure encrypted virtualization and records memory encryption state from boot parameters.
A helper that signals fatal failure of the trusted domain hypercall transport during compressed boot is globally visible.
The boot code makes available formatted text production into a caller supplied buffer with variable arguments.
The boot code makes available a validator that accepts or rejects the current processor against kernel build requirements.
The boot code makes available a checker that reports processor level required level and missing capability detail.
The boot code makes available a checker for a Xeon Phi erratum that limits thirty two bit kernels without paging extensions.
Low level copy helpers that move data with source or destination addressed through an alternate segment are globally visible.
Global processor description state and vendor word storage are visible across boot compilation units.
The compressed image defines separate entry symbols for sixty four bit and thirty two bit builds with the thirty two bit entry expected at address zero.
Stage two virtualization communication handling acts as an entry from early exception dispatch while decompression runs identity mapped.
Secure virtualization enablement acts as an early boot entry that consumes firmware boot parameters and establishes encryption state.
Processor checking and validation act as boot gate entries that run before decompression is allowed to proceed.
Processor capability state holds a level value where sixty four denotes long mode plus separate family and model integers plus an array of capability words sized by the architecture word count.
Boot parameter state observed here carries a setup data chain head in header state plus a thirty two bit confidential computing blob address used for hand off to later phases.
Confidential computing blob information observed here carries a magic value plus identification table location and length plus secrets location and length.
The secure nested paging identification table observed here carries a count plus function entries keyed by input leaf with output values supporting range maxima and feature advertisement.
The secrets page observed here carries a service size plus guest privilege level plus calling area address for secure service communication.
The register view observed here provides both a full sixty four bit value and split low and high parts for status and control access.
Repeat prefix detection reports presence when any decoded prefix matches either of two architecturally defined repeat encodings and reports absence otherwise.
Exception emulation decoding uses a bounded window from the saved instruction location decoded in long mode with a distinct signal for decode failure versus success.

During compressed boot segment base resolution is fixed to zero and port permission checks always approve and kernel space fault classification always reports false while memory move helpers act as plain copies reporting success.
Diagnostic output in the compressed secure virtualization path is compiled to no operation.
EFI based blob lookup reports absence cleanly when configuration table retrieval fails and otherwise searches for a vendor table identified as the confidential computing blob.
Blob discovery prefers EFI tables over setup data chaining and reports absence only when both sources lack a blob while a present blob with incorrect magic is fatal.
Setup data based blob discovery walks a singly linked list from boot header state and selects the entry whose type denotes a confidential computing blob returning its stored address.

Preliminary secure nested paging initialization indicates absence when boot parameters or blob information are missing and otherwise installs identification state records service state and publishes the blob address before indicating presence.

Identification table installation requires a present blob with a page sized table and a nonzero bounded count and copies firmware content into internal storage while deriving standard hypervisor and extended range maxima from specific leaves.
The internal identification table is reached through position independent addressing suitable for identity mapped early boot.

Secure service calling area setup reports absence at the highest privilege level and otherwise requires a page sized secrets page with nonzero service size and guest level and records privilege plus aligned area while advertising service presence in identification state.

Secure virtualization enablement clears prior hand off state and requires processor capability indications both before and after identification table installation proceeding only when those indications agree.
When enablement completes with encryption indicated in status an in memory encryption mask is derived from the capability bit position.
Hypervisor feature discovery yields zero when protocol version is below two or when response identity mismatches and otherwise yields feature bits from the response value.
The compressed boot status accessor unconditionally reports zero indicating no runtime secure virtualization state in this build.

Trusted domain port access in compressed boot uses hypercalls parameterized by access width direction port and value with read transport failure indicated by an all ones result and narrow helpers covering one and two byte widths.
Trusted domain hypercall collapse handling is terminal and attributes the failure to the host module.

The compressed image layout starts header code at zero followed by compressed read only data code read only data optional secure boot table page aligned writable data with legacy checksum padding cache aligned zero initialized data and page aligned paging structures on sixty four bit keeping total size page aligned.
The link enforces absence of global offset procedure linkage and dynamic relocation content with a narrowly defined allowance for procedure linkage size that differs by word width.
Segment copy helpers preserve caller segment state while moving memory with source or destination addressed through an alternate segment.
Processor name formatting yields a sixty four bit label for level sixty four and maps level fifteen to level six and otherwise formats a thirty two bit Intel style label from the level.
Formatted string production delegates to a shared formatter with variable arguments and returns the produced length.
Missing capability reporting scans all capability words and bits emitting a descriptive string when table alignment matches the word and bit indices and otherwise emitting a numeric word bit pair.
Boot processor acceptance requires detected level at least required level with no missing required capability bits and no applicable erratum and otherwise reports the deficiency and rejects.
Processor level starts from a baseline and promotes for later steppings based on flag behavior and long mode presence while missing capability state is computed against required masks.

When only narrowly scoped capability gaps remain the checker attempts vendor specific enablement for four distinct vendors before reevaluating including a command line gated promotion for one mobile processor case.
Vendor identity is decided by comparing three stored thirty two bit words against packed four character encodings for each vendor.
Missing capability computation records per word required but absent bits and summarizes whether any gap exists across words.
The Xeon Phi erratum gate only constrains a single Intel family model combination on thirty two bit without paging extensions and passes all other configurations.
Flag presence testing in this boot configuration unconditionally reports presence.
Required processor level derives from build minimum family and required capability masks are nonzero only for a defined subset of words with remaining words explicitly zero.
Processor description vendor words and a loaded indicator persist as boot global state established before validation.

Trampoline placement handling ensures the active top level paging structure resides outside trampoline memory while restoring original trampoline bytes with translation mode adjustment applied to the relocated copy.

Stage two exception handling moves among preparation validation exit specific emulation and completion with distinct outcomes for successful advance retry and terminal failure and with unsupported exits rejected.
Enablement occupies cleared hand off prechecked hinted verified negotiated validated and published states with silent return on absence and terminal handling on contradictory indications.
Processor checking occupies baseline gathered computed remediated and screened states where remediation applies only to narrowly scoped single capability gaps.
Calling area establishment occupies probed absent validated recorded and advertised states with terminal handling on malformed secrets or alignment inputs.

Malformed discovery inputs including bad magic missing or short tables unbounded counts missing or short secrets empty service description zero guest level and misaligned calling area cause immediate termination.
Negotiation failures including unsupported guest host protocol missing secure nested paging hypervisor indication and multi privilege operation without hypervisor support cause immediate termination.
Contradictory secure nested paging indications between blob presence and identification or status cause diagnostic error handling rather than silent enablement.
Trusted domain transport failure during port access is not retried and yields a maximal read value or proceeds for writes with a dedicated terminal path for outright call collapse.
Virtualization communication handling treats unknown exits as unsupported and treats non retry failures during preparation validation or emulation as terminal.
Boot on the affected Xeon Phi model with a thirty two bit kernel lacking paging extensions is refused with guidance toward sixty four bit or paging extension builds.
Processor validation failures due to insufficient level or missing capabilities produce human readable diagnostics including required names or numeric indices before rejection.
A required secure nested paging feature mask aggregates virtualization injection debugging privilege timing exit parameter register protection advanced interrupt and reserved bit groups.

An implemented feature mask combines debug swap secure timing and secure advanced interrupt behavior where the interrupt component selects between the architectural bit and zero based on build configuration.
Four character packing into thirty two bit words uses little endian byte order for vendor comparison.
Translation unit markers denote compressed boot context and initialization placement and header guards protect boot compressed processor flags and character type headers against multiple inclusion.
Boot setup data uses a dedicated type value for confidential computing blob entries and a defined magic for blob header validation.

Linkage requires page alignment for paging structures and overall image size plus cache line alignment for zero initialized data plus zero sizes for offset linkage and relocation sections with narrow procedure table allowance.
Repeat recognition covers encodings 0xF2 and 0xF3. Range maxima derive respectively from leaves 0x0 0x40000000 and 0x80000000 while service presence is advertised in leaf 0x8000001F.
Enablement observes status indicators for enabled encrypted state and secure nested paging plus hypervisor feature indicators for secure nested paging and multi privilege operation.
The erratum gate targets family 6 model 0x57 and mobile promotion concerns models 9 and 13 with level 15 aliased to level 6 and level 64 denoting long mode.
